items.title: From Molecule to Native Ansible-Test: Zero-Cost Validation Pipeline on Stargate
items.summary: Migrating from Docker-dependent Molecule testing to native ansible-test on stargate eliminates external container orchestration overhead, achieving zero-token shell executions within the lab topology.

items.title: Sunday Collection Coverage Audit: Ansible Test Gaps & Testing Infrastructure Stabilization
items.summary: Comprehensive code coverage audit of the lab.franklin Ansible collection across 43 roles (4,376 task lines). Only four roles have real integration tests; testing infrastructure pivoted to native ansible-test with pypi_internal as approved package source.

items.title: Lab Infrastructure Collapse Pattern: Host Inventory Decay Across a 10-Host Subnet Mesh
items.summary: An audit of lab.bitsmasher.net reveals ~40% of hosts unreachable or lost key auth within weeks. Root causes and remediation playbook.

items.title: Kerberos Keytabs That Never Worked: NFS Authorization Dead Ends in a Heterogeneous Lab
items.summary: NFS exports across chonk and stargate declare sec=krb5i but no client keytabs were ever deployed — every krb5 mount silently falls back to insecure access or fails entirely. A remediation playbook for a multi-host lab.

items.title: Tegra on the Edge: Why node90x Jetson Nanos Can't Talk to Their Own GPUs
items.summary: Three Jetson Nano 2GB Developer Kits with Tegra T210 SoCs have inaccessible integrated GPUs — no nvidia-smi, no OpenCL, no CUDA runtime. Root cause analysis and remediation.

items.title: The Architecture of Lawful Beginnings: FieldSemantics as a Formal Epistemic Protocol

items.title: Ansible Molecule at Scale: Why 37 Test Harnesses Timeout and How to Fix the Pipeline
items.summary: 37 Ansible roles have Molecule test harnesses on stargate, but the cron job times out at 600s. Diagnosing DNS vs NFS failure modes and proposing parallelization.
